arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test various timezone formats
test_cases = [
    ('+0100', '+01:00'),
    ('-0530', '-05:30'),
    ('+1000', '+10:00'),
    ('-0830', '-08:30'),
]

for input_tz, expected_name in test_cases:
    # Create a simple pattern that just captures the timezone
    r = parse.parse(f'a {input_tz} b', f'a {input_tz} b')
    print(f'Input: {input_tz!r}')
    
    # Parse using ti format
    dt_r = parse.parse(f'a {:ti} b', f'a 1997-07-16T19:20{input_tz} b')
    if dt_r:
        tz = dt_r.fixed[0].tzinfo
        print(f'  Parsed tz: {tz}')
        print(f'  Name: {tz._name}')
        print(f'  Offset: {tz._offset}')
    print()
"
